column7: Happy path: conforming HDR Profile, H1..H8 all OK; CRWL agrees with the HAGC reference white so H7 reaches its AGREE branch. PQ, so 8.10.4 does not resolve a content headroom

HDR-10: HAGC reference white 300 vs CRWL 203, so the two 8.10.4 carriers DISAGREE. Linear, so the division actually happens: HAGC-first gives 600/300=2, CRWL-first would give 600/203=2.9557. The only fixture in either corpus that distinguishes the two orders, and the only one reaching H7's DISAGREE branch

The two headroom axes divide by DIFFERENT reference whites: 8.10.4 content uses the HAGC-first 300, 8.10.5 c) display uses the CRWL entry 203, on the same 600 numerator. No DERH and no DRWL so 8.10.5 falls through to c), the only display rule consulting a reference white. Linear, so the content axis resolves at all. PAWG's own report contradicts itself on it: H7 states the content reference white is 300 while H8 divides by 203 and calls that same quantity the content HDR reference white
